description.en: A private research university near Boston, known for science and engineering. All undergraduates pay the same tuition.
description.ru: Частный исследовательский университет рядом с Бостоном, известный науками и инженерией. Все бакалавры платят одинаковую сумму.

notes_for_reviewer: Official registrar.mit.edu page read 2026-10-06: full tuition for 2026-2027 is USD 33,360 per term (fall and spring), stored as USD 66,720 per year. Student life fee, housing, food and books are extra (not collected; the cost-of-attendance total of about USD 92,760 came from a search summary). MIT meets the demonstrated financial need of admitted students including international ones (from the search summary; not verified here). This card is GENERIC (no majors, no ISCED-F code); the 4-year length is general knowledge. English tests, SAT policy and deadlines not collected.
